response.courseDescription: 596 Advanced Topics in Financial Economics May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 12 hours. Topics may include financial theory and empirical methods as applied to financial management, investments, international finance, and markets/institutions. (Crosslisted course offered as FIN 596, ECONS 596.)
response.coursePrerequisites: Admission to PhD programs in business, or ECONS 500 and ECONS 501.
